Title: Rachel Brandywine and the Discard Phase

Messages.Author: Magnus
Messages.Body:
Here愀 a question regarding the Discard Phase and the special from
Rachel.

The rulebook states, that you can discard one card during your Discard
Phase and draw a new one. If I were to use the Barrens and/or the
Fragment of the Book Nod after the Influence Phase, i.e. during the
Discard Phase, would the cards I have to discard count towards Rachels
special, i.e. go into my library again ?

Magnus

Messages.Author: Flux
Messages.Body:
Different question:

What happens to cards 'stolen' with Agaitas and discarded when you have
Rachel Brandywine?

Card text suggests the cards are discarded anyway (and so go to your
prey's ash heap), but OTOH nothing seems to prevent you from retrieving
those cards from his ash heap into your library, and that just sounds wrong.

I think you need errata to 'cards discarded [to your ash heap]...'

:/

Flux

Messages.Author: The Bard of Crete
Messages.Body:

This may not mean much, but cards stolen by Agiatas aren't actually in your
hand, they just count against your hand, and thus really not discarded from
your hand.

Messages.Author: Flux
Messages.Body:


I think it's the other way around, the cards are still in your hand,
they're just visible to all players (like in sup Revelations). Text on
Agaitas says the cards are still considered to be in your hand, to be
played or discarded as usual.

...and either way makes no difference anyway, since the only requirement
on Rachel is that the cards are 'discarded', doesn't matter where to or
from.

Flux
